channels.label: LinkedIn
channels.description: Company page linked from the official news footer, with public product posts and live-event invitations.

items.title: Introducing SUPERAGENT: AI sales assistant for insurance agents
items.summary: The company introduces its insurance sales assistant and invites readers to follow product previews, customer stories and updates about recruiting, training and retention.

items.title: Meet Quoting AI Agent for Insurance Agencies
items.summary: A company video post promotes its Quoting AI Agent and explains how it works with inbound and outbound agents to support quoting and cross-selling conversations.

items.title: February 17 YouTube live announcement
items.summary: SUPERAGENT invites insurance agencies to a live product announcement on YouTube on February 17, 2026, at 8 a.m. Pacific. The post supplies a registration or viewing link.

channels.label: YouTube
channels.description: Official video channel linked in the company's Business Wire release; launch videos are embedded on its website and press releases.

items.title: SUPERAGENT AI on YouTube
items.summary: The company's August 2026 Business Wire release identifies @getsuperagent as its YouTube profile. Its website directs visitors to watch the 3.0 launch keynote.

items.title: SUPERAGENT 3.0 Launch Keynote
items.summary: Launch keynote embedded on the official 3.0 product page, which presents the company's conversational workflow, campaign creation and producer-training capabilities.

channels.label: Website & resources
channels.description: Owned product pages, customer evidence and integration resources support evaluation alongside the company blog.

items.title: SUPERAGENT 3.0 — AI Business Partner
items.summary: Product landing page explaining the company's conversational agency workflows, campaign creation, call analysis and producer training. It includes a launch keynote and describes human approval before changes.

items.title: RightSure x SUPERAGENT AI case study
items.summary: Company-published case study describing RightSure's use of Training AI Agent and Analytics AI Agent. It presents the company's claims about onboarding speed and sales outcomes from a training pilot.

items.title: Connect SUPERAGENT to your insurance tools
items.summary: Integration directory listing agency management systems, CRMs, telephony and productivity tools. The page describes how the company says these connections support its inbound, outbound, training and quoting agents.

channels.label: Press releases
channels.description: Company-issued announcements distributed through newswires. These are press releases, not evidence of independent editorial coverage or paid ad activity.

items.title: Business Wire: SUPERAGENT AI 3.0 launches
items.summary: Company announcement introducing the 3.0 conversational business partner, campaign workflows and producer training. It highlights approval controls and directs readers to the launch keynote.

items.title: Business Wire: SUPERAGENT launches Platform 2.0
items.summary: Company release announcing a platform combining telephony, SMS, email, quoting and AI agents. It describes product capabilities and includes a customer statement from McGinnis Insurance Services.

items.title: PRWeb: invitation to the August 11 launch keynote
items.summary: Company-issued event announcement inviting viewers to the August 11, 2026 YouTube keynote. It previews conversational agency work and links to the launch registration page.
